place.source_title: Oak Park Theatre, 116-120 South Marion Street

brief: Two-storey 1913 vaudeville-and-movie theatre remodelled in 1929: a white stucco front with a stepped parapet, a big triangular marquee and a tall vertical blade sign, and a long plain brick auditorium behind along the alley.

facade.notes: the Oak Park Theatre (1913): a tall plain stucco box with a shaped parapet and a vertical steel-frame 'LAMAR' sign on its roof, a marquee canopy over the entrance; a commercial street of one- and two-storey shops beyond

why.note: the movie theatre: a blank auditorium box, its identity all in the marquee and sign
